source: iprof (note 92 ; appareils génériques, sauvegarde, migration, sections notées 4-5), marcordi (mains sur la tablette, établi de dépannage, câble débranché ; 404 et tarifs à refaire pour « prise américaine »), bvcomm (fibre, câblage), tvcentreduquebec (téléviseur à lueur abstraite, notée 4-5), warmline-app.
style: Warm documentary editorial photography, 35mm lens, {ambiance} mood, palette of {palette}, {lumiere}, tactile {matieres}, set in {lieu} on {saison}, shallow depth of field, soft film grain, calm and reassuring, generous negative space.
interdits: No brand logo on devices, no apple logo, no readable screen, no interface, no code on screen, no hologram, no futuristic overlay, no visible face.
evite: Évite l'écran lisible et la personne cadrée à mi-corps (marcordi) : écrans tournés ou lueur abstraite, appareils génériques, mains seules ou personne de dos.

404.consigne: An unplugged power cable hanging over the edge of a wooden table, its plug dangling in mid-air above the floor, a plain wall behind, soft warm light, minimalist and slightly humorous, nobody in the frame.
404.evite: La personne qui apparaissait dans la première version.

ouverture.consigne: Close-up of an elderly person's hands and a younger helper's hands resting together on {sujet} on a worn oak kitchen table, morning sunlight through a window, a cup of coffee nearby, the screen turned away or softly blurred, only those hands visible.
ouverture.evite: Le visage du client (marcordi : « prise américaine »).

section-fond.consigne: A dim living room at night seen from a low angle, a large screen on the wall glowing with a soft abstract gradient, no picture content, the right half of the frame dark and calm.

scene-metier.consigne: A calm, tidy wooden workbench seen from a slight high angle: {sujet}, an open laptop with its screen facing away, a small precision screwdriver set, a neatly coiled cable, all plain and unbranded.

lieu.consigne: Bright entryway of a home: a canvas tote bag with a laptop sleeve placed on a wooden bench, a coat on a hook, the front door half open letting in warm light, welcoming and calm, no people.

texture.consigne: Macro photograph of {matieres}, warm raking light making the metal glow, very shallow depth of field, subject on the right, calm empty space on the left.

portrait-generique.consigne: View from behind a sofa: the silhouette of an adult seen strictly from the back, relaxed, a knitted throw on the shoulders, a screen in front showing only a soft abstract glow, no face, no profile.
